description.summary: keep toplevels out of screen captures

protocol.description:
This protocol lets a client keep one of its toplevels out of captures of the screen: screen casts of monitors and areas, and screenshots of the screen. The window stays on the screen. It is meant for windows that would otherwise capture themselves, such as a recorder's controls or a streaming app's preview, and for content the client does not want shared.
Hiding only removes content from what is captured, so the compositor needs no permission for it. A capture of the window itself, chosen by the user, still shows it.

interface.name: luma_window_capture_manager_v1
interface.description: A global that gives toplevels a luma_window_capture_v1 object.

entry.name: already_constructed
entry.summary: the surface already has a luma_window_capture_v1 object

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroys the manager. Objects created through it are not affected.

request.name: get_window_capture

description.summary: get the capture object of a surface

request.description:
Creates the capture object of the given surface. A surface has at most one; asking for a second one while the first exists is the already_constructed protocol error.
The object takes a wl_surface rather than an xdg_toplevel so that toolkits which keep their xdg_toplevel private can use it. Its state has an effect only while the surface has the xdg_toplevel role, and it stays with the surface if the role object is destroyed and created again.

interface.name: luma_window_capture_v1
interface.description: Whether captures of the screen show the xdg_toplevel of one wl_surface. A new object starts visible. set_visibility is double buffered: it takes effect on the next wl_surface.commit, like xdg_toplevel.set_min_size. Once the surface is destroyed, requests are ignored; the object should then be destroyed.

entry.name: invalid_visibility
entry.summary: the visibility is not a value of the visibility enum

entry.name: visible
entry.summary: captures of the screen show the window

entry.name: hidden
entry.summary: captures of the screen leave the window out

request.name: destroy

description.summary: show the window in captures again

request.description: Destroys the object. The window is visible to captures again at once.

request.name: set_visibility

description.summary: show or hide the window in captures

request.description:
With hidden, captures of the screen leave the window out: screen casts of a monitor or an area, and screenshots of the screen or an area, show what is behind it instead, as if the window were not there. Windows transient for it (dialogs, menus, popups) are left out as well. The window stays on the screen and keeps its input.
A capture of the window itself, such as a window screen cast the user picked, still shows it. A compositor may mark the window in its screen sharing dialogs.
